keywords: Entered into an agreement with the 3rd Respondent empowered under Section 17(1) of the Greater Colombo Economic Commission Law; exemption to Customs Ordinance in terms of Schedule B of the Act; objection on reliance of outdated regulations; legitimate expectation of the Petitioner. Held - Based on evidence, Application dismissed with costs.
